name: M0-MD0_BARE_BONES_MARKET_COMPARISON_V0
purpose: Diagnostic comparison of frozen M0 OOF winner probabilities with historical listed UFC market probabilities.

market.cross_book_aggregation: not applicable to the selected single listed source

matching.name_resolution: conservative normalized display name to unique canonical fighter_id
matching.orientation: market probability reoriented to F02/M0 canonical fighter_1

incremental_information.evaluation: expanding-year chronological walk-forward over matched rows
incremental_information.preprocessing: logit clipping only, fixed at 1e-6; training uses prior matched years only

classification_policy.MARKET_COMPETITIVE: M0 is within 0.015 log loss and 0.0075 Brier of market and either fixed blend beats both or chronological M0 addition passes the complementary-information rule.
classification_policy.MARKET_COMPLEMENTARY: Chronological market+M0 beats calibrated market-only on aggregate log loss and Brier, improves both in at least half of folds, and the M0 logit coefficient is positive in more folds than negative.
classification_policy.MARKET_DOMINANT: No complementary-information rule passes and raw market beats M0 by more than 0.02 log loss and 0.01 Brier.
classification_policy.MARKET_REDUNDANT: None of the above; M0 adds no robust incremental evidence under V0.
classification_policy.INSUFFICIENT_MARKET_DATA: Used instead of a performance classification if provenance, timing characterization, matching ambiguity, or matched coverage fails the acceptance bar.
